name: Anterior Tibialis-SMR
instructions: Begin seated on the ground with your legs bent and your feet on the floor.

Using a Muscle Roller or a rolling pin, apply pressure to the muscles on the outside of your shins. Work from just below the knee to above the ankle, pausing at points of tension for 10-30 seconds. Repeat on the other leg.
prompt: This is a Anterior Tibialis-SMR for stretching that uses static force to primarily train the calves. These are the instructions that a person would receive: "Begin seated on the ground with your legs bent and your feet on the floor. Using a Muscle Roller or a rolling pin, apply pressure to the muscles on the outside of your shins. Work from just below the knee to above the ankle, pausing at points of tension for 10-30 seconds. Repeat on the other leg."
